declared_definition: distance from the player to the nearest defender at the frame tagged pass_forward
event_definition: one value per player-play, sampled at the pass release; the release frame itself is not delivered with the value
zero_encoding: 0 would be a physical distance of zero; no structural zero is expected
missing_meaning: null = not recorded (no pass released, or the player was not in a route) — never read as a separation of 0
attribution: recorded on the receiver's row; the defender is not named
opportunity: route snaps on plays with a released pass; whether non-targeted receivers are included is MEASURED, not assumed
eligibility: eligible window of notebook 05A (REG season, in-scope position, not nullified by penalty, usable quality tier)
limits: an interaction outcome: receiver, nearest defender, coverage call, route depth and throw timing together
status_basis: inferred from the column name and internal consistency; no vendor definition recorded

declared_definition: the player was credited with a (solo) tackle on the play
event_definition: a credited statistic of the play, not a tracking event; the tracking tag 'tackle' marks a frame of the play
zero_encoding: a recorded 0 exists: its meaning (assist only, missed tackle, other credited action) is MEASURED against the companion fields
missing_meaning: null = no tackle statistic recorded for the player on the play; 'no credit' is an inference, not a recorded 0
attribution: player-level credit; solo versus assisted depends on the companion field 'assist'
opportunity: no field records a tackle OPPORTUNITY (plays run at the player, tackle attempts); only snaps on the field are observed
eligibility: eligible window of notebook 05A (REG season, in-scope position, not nullified by penalty, usable quality tier)
limits: credit depends on role, scheme, run direction and playing time; a raw count is not a tackling skill
status_basis: inferred from the column name and internal consistency; no vendor definition recorded

declared_definition: sack credit of the player on the play (0.5 = shared sack)
event_definition: a credited statistic of the play; the tracking tag 'qb_sack' marks a frame of the play
zero_encoding: 0 is recorded explicitly on a subset of plays; which plays is MEASURED (it is not assumed to be pass-rush snaps)
missing_meaning: null = no sack statistic recorded on the play (for instance a run play) — never read as 0
opportunity: the recorded rows are a candidate denominator; whether the player actually rushed the passer on them is not recorded
eligibility: eligible window of notebook 05A (REG season, in-scope position, not nullified by penalty, usable quality tier)
limits: rare event; depends on rush assignment, protection, quarterback and game script
